rows.evidence: The unmodified base checkout reproduced the empty overlay query; repository patch 0001 fixes only the existing parent-location plus overlay_seq lookup, and m35_xyz_material_query_test plus m2_1_xyz_api_test prove the real public query and privacy projections.
rows.impact: Canonical M3.5 observations expose visible material identity through the existing overlay_seq contract and continue to redact opponent face-down material identity.
rows.m3_5_action: retain the patch as an ordered repository input and prepare an upstream-compatible change if accepted; until then the base cached core remains immutable
rows.m3_action: M3.1 limitation closed by the narrow repository-versioned ocgcore patchset; no second overlay-query mechanism was added.
rows.privacy_implications: Identity is exposed only after the same parent visibility gate used for the visible Xyz card; hidden paired-world material identities remain redacted and hash-equal.
rows.scope: pinned ocgcore public API 11.0 plus the OCGForge derived patchset

rows.evidence: Current fixture setup is intentionally script-backed; no general board-construction API is required by the closed fixtures and no missing ocgcore capability has been proven.
rows.impact: M3 does not add a general public board-construction API or private core access.
rows.m3_5_action: evaluate a descriptor-backed fixture setup projection if more coverage requires it
rows.privacy_implications: Any future setup projection must remain test-only and must not widen runtime hidden-information access.
rows.scope: OCGForge test infrastructure, not an upstream ocgcore gap

rows.evidence: The unmodified base API had no starting-player setter and always initialized player 0; repository patch 0002 adds only OCG_DuelSetStartingPlayer before duel start, preserves default 0, rejects invalid values and post-start calls, and is proven by m35_starting_player_api_test plus canonical full-game partitions.
rows.impact: Canonical M3.5 runners can deterministically exercise starting-player 0 and 1 while retaining the same default behavior and deck-seat semantics.
rows.m3_5_action: retain the additive setter as an ordered repository input and prepare an upstream-compatible change with regression tests if accepted
rows.m3_action: M3.1 limitation closed by the narrow repository-versioned ocgcore patchset; no mid-duel turn-player mutation API was added.
rows.privacy_implications: No hidden card information is exposed; the patch changes only pre-duel turn-player selection and acceptance coverage.
rows.scope: pinned ocgcore public API 11.0 plus the OCGForge derived patchset
